plan.title: SRC-TNC-021 Mandatory Terms Accepted in Single-Stage Auction

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the buyer to add vendors during event creation.
Configure a price-based reverse auction awarded as one lot.
Provide the required event title.
Choose the buy/reverse-auction pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required by the create screen.
Set the first line item's delivery location.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory so both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop on the completed event create screen

steps.note: Configure the two required clauses and the mandatory-all setting, which has no dedicated domain step.
Verify the payment clause is present after configuring terms.
Verify the delivery clause is present after configuring terms.
Add the available QA vendor to the event.
Commit the immediate 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify the event reached its published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal in the separate session.
Open the event's auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Have the vendor accept the first mandatory clause.
Have the vendor accept the second mandatory clause.
Quote 100 for the line and submit after accepting both clauses.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer-side confirmation that bidders accepted the mandatory terms.
